before: Charleston's construction boom has increased workplace injuries including falls, electrocutions, struck-by incidents, and caught-between accidents — OSHA's "Fatal Four" hazards. Injured workers may collect South Carolina workers' compensation benefits regardless of fault, and may also pursue third-party claims against negligent subcontractors, equipment manufacturers, or property owners for additional damages. Independent contractors face different rules than employees. South Carolina's three-year filing deadline (S.C. Code SS 15-3-530) applies to third-party claims, while workers' comp has separate deadlines.
